He is accused of misusing K38.5 millions of taxpayers’ money and coercing an accountant to authorize the payment. He became the first officer from the Army's Infantry Corps to lead the MDF. == Background == === Early life and career === Phiri was born on 24 August in 1972 in Blantyre, Malawi.
